assets.name: unit_runner
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production-ready mobile tower-defense game class selection portrait, standalone square raster icon with a genuinely transparent background. Art direction: original premium stylized 3D game illustration, charming and confident rather than childish, chunky expertly designed silhouette, polished hand-painted materials, subtle faceted construction, rounded bevels, strong readable light/dark shapes, warm soft key light from upper left and restrained cool rim light. Three-quarter view, slightly elevated camera, subject centered and fully visible, fills about 78 percent of the square with generous clean transparent padding all around. It must read instantly at 72 pixels, with large meaningful details and minimal tiny texture. Rich saturated class accent colors balanced with charcoal, ivory and warm stone. No text, letters, numbers, logos, card frame, interface, scenery, ground tile, backdrop, cast shadow extending outside subject, or watermark. No imitation of any existing game character. Maintain this same art direction for a cohesive nine-icon set.
Subject: one original GREEN RUNNER troop. A compact emerald-green walking pebble-golem scout with an oval round body, two expressive ivory eyes with dark pupils, subtly raised determined brows, two stout dark charcoal boots, tiny green arms close to the body. Smooth forest-green armor-like stone plates and a few softly faceted surfaces. A little olive-gold collar accent. Clear agile stepping pose with one foot forward, friendly determined face. This is a simple dependable basic troop, not a warrior with a weapon. Entire body visible, large clear face and boots. Only one creature. Transparent background.
assets.visual_review: Accepted: class silhouette, no text, complete subject, consistent materials. Individual review at source resolution; final HUD review pending.
